description: Principal, interest and remaining balance over the life of one loan. Yearly summary by default; period 'month' gives every payment (up to 120 rows). When optional inputs are omitted, the result includes assumed_defaults (the values actually used) and a short text line so you can call again with those parameters. assumed_defaults is omitted when every optional input was provided. Only for US car loans in US dollars: pass country "US" and currency "USD". Do not call this tool for a loan in any other country or currency (for example the UK, £/GBP or €/EUR); tell the user that only US car loans in USD are supported.

apr.description: Yearly interest rate in percent, compounded monthly (the same number as the site’s rate field), e.g. 6.5 for 6.5%. A lender’s APR can be a little higher because it folds in some fees. Use 0 for 0% financing.

country.description: Country of the purchase, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Must be "US": only US car loans in USD are supported.

currency.description: Currency of every amount, ISO 4217. Must be "USD": only US car loans in USD are supported.

down.description: Cash down payment in USD. Default 0.

fees.description: Title, registration, documentation and dealer fees in USD. Default 0.

owed_on_trade_in.description: Loan balance still owed on the trade-in, rolled into the new loan (negative equity). Default 0.

price.description: Vehicle price in USD (before tax, fees, down payment and trade-in).

sales_tax_rate.description: Sales tax in percent of the vehicle price, e.g. 7 for 7%. No state rules or trade-in tax credit are applied. Default 0.

tax_and_fees_financed.description: false (default, the site's "Pay upfront"): sales tax and fees are paid in cash at purchase, not financed. true: they are added to the loan.

trade_in.description: Trade-in value in USD credited against the price. Default 0.

name: amortization_schedule

assumed_defaults.description: Optional inputs the caller omitted, with the values actually used. The field is omitted when nothing was assumed.

end_balance.description: Remaining loan balance at the end of this year, in USD.

interest.description: Interest paid in this year, in USD.

months.description: Inclusive payment-number range in this year, for example "1–12".

paid.description: Total paid in this year, in USD.

principal.description: Principal repaid in this year, in USD.

balance.description: Remaining loan balance after this payment, in USD.

interest.description: Interest paid this month, in USD.

principal.description: Principal repaid this month, in USD.

title: Auto loan amortization schedule
